candidate_program.name: count_priority_with_mean_conflict_regret
candidate_program.rationale: Prioritizes fewer blocked contacts and resolves equal counts using bounded reward versus mean-conflict regret. Count and reward scales remain separate; there is no added graph computation or remote structural information.

comparison: exact rational comparison of returned binary float scores
cost_scope: Cached offline score-fit evaluation only; does not replace complete-schedule charged cost
